author: ReginaldTang
title: Settings window fails to navigate to the Mouse Without Borders page

status.label: Reproducible navigation hypothesis
status.detail: The page is explicitly registered in Settings navigation; a page-construction or initialization failure is plausible but not confirmed.

next_action.label: Reproduce MWB Settings navigation failure
next_action.reason: Trace the frame navigation and page constructor to identify why selecting the registered page leaves the previous page visible.

judgment.rationale: The issue gives a clear route and expected/actual result, and includes a recording. Current Settings XAML explicitly maps the Mouse Without Borders navigation item to MouseWithoutBordersPage; its constructor creates the view model and settings file watcher before InitializeComponent. A synchronous page-construction or initialization exception is therefore a plausible explanation for the unchanged frame, but no exception or diagnostic trace is supplied and the single triage-bot comment adds no further evidence. This remains a red hypothesis, not a completed design.
evidence: The report reproduces on Microsoft Store PowerToys 0.101.2362: open Settings and navigate to Mouse Without Borders; the previous page remains visible.
A video attachment is present and the only discussion comment is the automated triage summary.

Current upstream ShellPage.xaml registers MouseWithoutBordersNavigationItem with `views:MouseWithoutBordersPage`; the page constructor creates MouseWithoutBordersViewModel and a settings file watcher before InitializeComponent.
No linked PR, duplicate, assignee, or maintainer diagnosis appears in the issue timeline.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce the recorded route on the reported and current Store builds while capturing Settings navigation/page-construction exceptions; fix the failing activation path and add focused navigation coverage only after that branch is identified.

fix_assessment.rationale: A Settings code fix is likely applicable; because the route is registered and no error trace is available, the suspected failure during page construction/initialization has red confidence and must be reproduced before design.

proposed_fixes.title: Repair the failing Mouse Without Borders Settings page activation
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: Settings resolves the registered MouseWithoutBordersPage route but a synchronous exception during page/view-model construction or initialization prevents the frame from replacing the previous page.
plan: Reproduce navigation from a working Settings page on the reported 0.101.2362 Store build and a current build; capture the NavigationService/frame failure and any exception from MouseWithoutBordersPage construction.
Trace the first failing constructor, settings IPC, or file-watcher operation and correct that specific activation failure without changing unrelated module navigation.
Add a focused Settings navigation test that opens Mouse Without Borders, verifies the page content and selected navigation item, and returns to the prior page.
verification: Repeat the issue's navigation sequence on the affected and current builds and confirm the MWB page renders.
Run focused Settings navigation coverage for MWB and a neighboring module page.

confidence.rationale: The route and page construction sites are known, but no log or error identifies which activation operation fails.

issue_context.summary: Selecting the Mouse Without Borders Settings page leaves the previous page visible on the reported Store build.
known_information: The issue gives PowerToys 0.101.2362 Stable from Microsoft Store and exact steps to navigate to the MWB page.
The reporter expects the MWB page to appear; the observed result is that the prior page stays visible.
A recording and one automated triage comment are present; no author/maintainer diagnosis or linked work is present.
inferences: Because the navigation route is explicitly registered, page construction or initialization may be failing after selection, but the issue does not prove that route resolution succeeds.
The recording may help reproduce the visual symptom, but no exception or Settings log is supplied.
issue_context.analysis: The report is specific enough for a maintainer to reproduce without asking the reporter to repeat the same steps. The code path narrows the first inspection to route resolution and synchronous page construction; the source does not yet justify a more specific code change.
initial_investigation: Read the full live report, video link, sole triage-bot comment, labels, and timeline; no linked PR or duplicate was found.
Checked current upstream ShellPage.xaml route registration and MouseWithoutBordersPage constructor; the page constructs its view model and watcher before XAML initialization.

actions.label: Approve focused Settings navigation investigation
actions.note: This approves a fork-side investigation after reproduction; it is not an implementation-grade design.

reproduce.title: Trace Settings navigation to Mouse Without Borders
reproduce.version_requirement: Microsoft Store PowerToys 0.101.2362 Stable as reported, then the current stable build.
prerequisites: Settings opens and at least one other Settings page can be selected.
Mouse Without Borders is installed/enabled as in the reported build.
steps: Open PowerToys Settings and select a different page first.
Select Mouse Without Borders from Settings navigation and record whether the navigation item becomes selected.
Capture Settings logs or debugger output for NavigationService/frame navigation and MouseWithoutBordersPage construction.
Repeat by navigating to a neighboring module page to compare page activation.
reproduce.expected_result: The MWB page replaces the previous page and renders; any failure should identify the exact route or constructor/initialization exception.
